identity.name: ANESTET — light and dark storefront
identity.topic: Professional skincare ecommerce with Clinical Luxe light theme and Chromatic Serum dark theme
identity.audience: Cosmetologists and clients choosing professional pre- and post-procedure skincare
identity.primary_action: Choose a product by care stage and add it to cart

art_direction.direction: Clinical editorial laboratory: bright precision versus deep navy antipode, unified by real packshots, original wordmarks and one restrained moving brand rail
art_direction.signature: Choose one memorable visual or interaction motif rooted in Professional skincare ecommerce with Clinical Luxe light theme and Chromatic Serum dark theme; repeat it with restraint rather than adding unrelated effects.
art_direction.differentiation: The concept must be explainable in one sentence and must not depend on a copied reference layout.
anti_template: Do not begin from a generic centered headline plus floating card grid.
Do not copy another site's composition, assets, typography or motion sequence pixel-for-pixel.
Do not use purple-gradient, beige editorial, dark-slate SaaS or bento-card defaults unless the subject itself demands them.

supplied_proof: Original ANESTET and Queen Key logos
content_truth.rule: Testimonials, metrics, awards, scarcity, prices and guarantees must come from supplied evidence or remain clearly marked placeholders.

available: Queen Key Recovery Milk hero image
Generated evidence image with exact hero product
assets.missing_rule: Use image search, supplied media or generated bitmap assets. The primary visual must show the real subject, product, place, person or learning outcome.

constraints: Exactly two visual themes: Clinical Luxe light and Chromatic Serum dark
Clinical product shadows visible without hover
Diagonal ANESTET marquee on hero and horizontal marquee in footer
Preserve verified product facts and contacts
brief.first_viewport: Make the brand/product/place/person or literal offer unmistakable, avoid a split-card hero, and keep a visible hint of the next section on mobile and desktop.
acceptance: Original visual language with a single coherent point of view
Responsive layout with no overlap or clipped text
Keyboard, semantic, contrast and reduced-motion accessibility
Real visual assets and truthful evidence
Measured performance and browser verification before release

layout_system.grid: Use stable responsive tracks and constrained content widths; allow deliberate asymmetry only when reading order remains obvious.
layout_system.spacing: Use a named spacing scale and section rhythm; avoid turning full-width sections into floating cards.
layout_system.cards: Cards are for repeated items, modals and framed tools only. No nested cards. Default radius is 8px or less.
layout_system.type: Reserve display scale for the true hero. Use compact headings in panels. Font size must not scale directly with viewport width; letter spacing is zero, never negative.
layout_system.controls: Use familiar icons for tool actions, proper controls for settings, visible focus states, and tooltips for unfamiliar icon-only actions.

palette_rule: Use a subject-specific multi-note palette with neutral support and one purposeful accent; reject one-hue and fashionable default palettes that obscure the subject.
asset_plan: Hero asset reveals the real subject rather than acting as dark, blurred atmosphere.
Each major section earns its media; decorative assets do not compete with evidence.
Define aspect ratio and dimensions before loading to prevent layout shift.
Record source, license and generation provenance for every non-owned asset.
responsive_plan: Keep the primary CTA and next-section hint visible without content overlap.
Long words, localized text, hover labels and dynamic content must not resize fixed-format controls.
Recompose, do not merely shrink, expressive desktop layouts on mobile.
